fields.statement: At 4c73aede (attempt 2, fixing quality f1) read the diff: parseFailedTests now drops any name another '--- FAIL:' line extends with name+'/', keeping only leaf tests; TestParseFailedTests' nested case now expects only TestScripts/review-check-worktree (two-tests and infra cases unchanged), and run-ship-ci-fix's fake gh log names TestScripts/x and TestScripts/x/sub and its fixer asserts the ship check JSON holds TestScripts/x/sub and not the bare parent.
